title: Luke 16:1-8
subtitle: Friday of the 31st Week in Ordinary Time · Phil 3:17—4:1; Ps 122; Lk 16:1-8
text: Jesus tells of a dishonest steward who, about to lose his place, shrewdly settles debts so others will welcome him. The master praises not the fraud but the foresight. If the children of this world plan so carefully for comfort, how carefully should the children of light plan for heaven.
imageAlt: Two men in fur-trimmed robes sit at a cluttered desk with ledgers, coins, and papers; one writes while the other looks on, illustrating the parable of the unjust steward.
